description: Platform-neutral behaviour specifications for Faithful primitives. These describe intent and required states; SwiftUI and Compose each implement them natively. No UI code is shared between platforms.
principles: Every interactive element declares all of: rest, pressed, focused, disabled, loading.
Every control meets the touch-target minimum even when its visual box is smaller.
Every control carries an accessibility label that reads as a sentence, not a token name.
Colour never carries meaning alone; pair it with text, icon, or shape.
A control that triggers a network call shows progress in place and stays measurable.

buttonPrimary.role: The one action a screen most wants

states.loading: inline spinner replaces label, width held constant

buttonPrimary.accessibility: Label states the outcome ('Save changes'), never the mechanism ('Submit').

buttonSecondary.role: A real alternative, not a lesser primary

buttonIcon.role: Compact affordance in a dense bar
buttonIcon.note: Visual box may be 32; the tappable area is still 48.

navigationBar.title: titleLarge, truncates at one line
navigationBar.largeTitle: displayMedium on scroll-to-top where the platform supports it
navigationBar.platformNote: iOS uses a native NavigationStack bar with back-swipe; Android uses a TopAppBar with the system back handler. These differ on purpose and are not a parity defect.

tabBar.note: Destinations register themselves; a tab appears only when its feature is both implemented and authorized.

textField.accessibility: Error text is associated with the field, not merely adjacent to it.

searchField.note: Debounce is a network courtesy, never a delay on what the person typed appearing.

card.note: One idea per card. A card that needs a scrollbar is the wrong container.

mediaCard.note: Artwork arrives with later features. Until then this primitive is unused rather than filled with stock imagery.

statusChip.accessibility: Chip text is read as part of its row, not as a standalone control.

listRow.accessibility: The whole row is one element with one combined label and one action.

sheet.platformNote: iOS presents a sheet with detents; Android uses a Material bottom sheet with predictive-back. Both dismiss on scrim tap and on the system back gesture.

banner.note: An offline banner never hides the cached content beneath it.

toast.note: Never the only place a result is communicated.

skeleton.note: Skeletons mirror the real layout's shape. A skeleton that does not match what loads is a worse lie than a spinner.

emptyState.note: States why it is empty and what would fill it. Never invented sample rows.

structure: cached content, labelled with its age

errorState.note: Never a code, never a stack trace, never a raw server message.

permissionEducation.rule: The OS prompt is only ever raised after this screen and an explicit tap. Declining is a first-class outcome, not a dead end.

authScreen.note: No social proof, no marketing copy, no fake testimonials.

churchSwitcher.note: Lists only churches with a real relationship. Selecting one sets a preference; it grants nothing, and every destination re-checks authorization.
